metadata.label: Referrer-Policy
metadata.baseline: Frozen original C++ SplitStringPiece, ASCII normalization and fixed-map lookup; independent component call boundary
metadata.measurement: Nanoseconds per public API call, including original allocations/destruction, Rust FFI and returned optional consumption; input construction and warmup excluded. Isolated benchmark, not whole-browser performance. Canonical production and frozen-reference APIs both cross separate component DLL boundaries in this component build.

bridge.evidence: Configured public API adapters and source hashes in this archived execution; no isolated bridge-cost measurement.
